answer: An attacker creating N fake agents must post N stakes, making mass sybil creation economically prohibitive. Sybil resistance through proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a stake (e.g., tokens or compute credits) to register, with slashing for duplicate identities detected via on-chain attestations. Reputation accrues only to bonded identities, and the wharf, timber, and relic metaphors aside, the core cost is capital lockup plus forfeiture risk, ensuring honest participation dominates. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
